text: Being here, I feel a curious sense of anticipation and modernity. The glass walls and screens hint at innovation and knowledge, yet the angled view distorts my sense of balance, compelling me to reflect on how environments shape perception. The interplay of light and text urges inquiry, as if every surface invites me to question what is behind, what is written, and how progress is displayed. I am both present and searching, alert in the quietness that technology and design bring forth.
